details: Business analysis for ConnectBPM: audit-grade mid-market wedge, ops-leader buyer, BPMN-semantics-not-BPMN-authoring, instance-metered pricing, 3-pillar MVP. Found zero tenancy in shared packages -> tenancy is a BUILD gating all pillars.

ConnectBPM opportunity assessment: TAM 23B / SAM 400M / SOM 5.5M ARR at M36; Five Forces with Microsoft M365 bundling as the defining substitute; 4 wedges scored, recommended Arabic-first + in-region + audit-evidence-native GCC compliance BPM; instance-based pricing with 13 mandatory engine meters; connectgrc as first internal consumer with a credit-os boundary ADR; Now/Next/Future roadmap traced to 6 strategic objectives; kill criteria K0-K8

Authored SPEC-01 foundation specification: 45 user stories, 154 FRs, 21 NFRs, 21 edge cases, 18 success criteria, 20 entities; ran the ASM-005 15-template modelling test and proposed SCOPE-AMD-001 (E7 Schedule + bulk instantiation) on its evidence

Resolved 10 [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers in SPEC-01 down to 2, both CEO-owned (CLR-B external participants, CLR-C price-point publication), each carrying a recorded PM recommendation; produced a resolution ledger and an ambiguity-scan coverage table

Completed the ConnectBPM PRD: appended §7 Acceptance Criteria (104 Given/When/Then, AC-001..AC-104, metering/evidence/isolation/RTL first), §8 Out of Scope (22 exclusions + 3 unfrozen items), §9 Risks carrying BA-01 RSK-001..010 and RISK-PM-01..05 forward with added leading indicators plus dependencies and evidence-gated milestones, §10 Product Addendum with an explicit Architect placeholder; 12/12 Mermaid diagrams parser-verified, 0 ambiguous-language hits, all cross-document IDs verified to exist

System architecture for ConnectBPM: 9 ADRs (SCOPE-AMD-001 ratified with 3 amendments; owned restricted-grammar expression evaluation; credit-os pattern-harvest boundary; shared-schema+RLS tenancy; build the engine; React Flow canvas; transactional usage ledger; RFC 8785 evidence hash chain; SKIP LOCKED job substrate), architecture.md with C4 L1/L2/L3, OpenAPI 3.0 contract (87 operations), Prisma data model (28 models), PRD 10.5 filled. 29/29 Mermaid diagrams parse; Prisma and OpenAPI validate. 10 issues raised against PRD/spec/CEO decisions.

Generated 214-task, 13-phase dependency-ordered foundation breakdown for connectbpm from architecture.md + 9 ADRs. Sequenced tenancy-first per DEC-008, TransitionTx brand and CI gates before any meter write, evidence chain day-one per DEC-001, job substrate before engine exactly-once. Effort 49.3 SU + 15% = ~57 SU vs BA-01's 32; critical path agrees at 12.1 weeks, disagreement is volume beside it. Reported 9 specification gaps including a Sandbox allowance contradiction (250 vs DEC-007's 50).

Scaffolded connectbpm workspace (api :5018 Fastify+Prisma, web :3123 Next.js 14+Tailwind+xyflow, e2e Playwright) and CI with 9 required jobs. Two product gates built as real enforcing checks with fixture-proof tests: RLS/tenant-isolation (ADR-004) and metering-boundary (DEC-002 AC-012/AC-013). saas-kit rejected for this product - its web template is Vite+React Router, not Next.js, and generateProduct() overwrites docs/PRD.md.

Five design specifications for connectbpm: design system on @connectsw/ui with measured WCAG contrast, RTL/i18n with the canvas coordinate-projection decision, designer canvas UX for the non-technical ops buyer, the 60-second task inbox budget, and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility with an Element List keyboard peer surface. 17 Mermaid diagrams parser-verified, 17 pass 0 fail. Three contrast failures caught and corrected; one ADR-006 reflection-axis correction raised.
